headline: Nevish Line Leads Renewed Base Fighting
war_summary: Nevish Line has widened its lead in the base returns since the last edition, reaching 69 events in the past day against 57 previously; 20 came in the latest two hours. Its strategic bases stand at six Warden, one Colonial and one neutral. Weathered Expanse has 51 events, just below its prior 52, and its balance now reads two Warden, four Colonial and three neutral—one more Colonial-held base and one fewer neutral than before. Kuura Strand, down to 28 events from 38, has seen two in the latest two hours; five bases are Colonial-held and one is neutral. Marban Hollow also records 28 events, but none in the latest six hours, with four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral base. Linn Mercy remains at 11 daily events and has been quiet recently; Godcrofts reports six, last recorded early today. Stlican Shelf has three events in the past day. Heavy casualty activity continues in several sectors, but War 140 remains undecided, with 34 victory towns required.
